title: Weekend Hub Dispatch and Zone Pricing for Mobile In-Home Collection Trips
content:
**Dispatch memo — Mobile In-Home Collection Visit, Specimen Collection Appointments.**

On weekends, home trips leave from the regional hubs rather than the neighborhood service center. The zone band at which a home trip is priced — its pricing band — therefore follows the day of the week of the appointment date:

- a visit whose appointment date is a **Sunday** is priced **two zone bands farther out** than the band it was booked in;
- a visit whose appointment date is a **Saturday** is priced **one zone band farther out** than the band it was booked in;
- a visit on a **weekday** (Monday to Friday) is priced on the band it was booked in.

The band never goes beyond service zone 3. The trip is priced at the published trip fee of the pricing band: 75.00 for service zone 1, 95.00 for service zone 2 and 125.00 for service zone 3.

## Pricing band by booked band and day

| Band booked (service zone on the visit) | Weekday | Saturday | Sunday |
|---|---|---|---|
| Service zone 1 | Zone 1 | Zone 2 | Zone 3 |
| Service zone 2 | Zone 2 | Zone 3 | Zone 3 (two bands out would pass zone 3; the band stops at zone 3) |
| Service zone 3 | Zone 3 | Zone 3 | Zone 3 |

## Records read

The appointment date and the service zone on the visit record. The day of the week is that of the appointment date, not of the booking date or of the day the charge is posted.

## Examples (hypothetical visits)

- Booked in service zone 1 for a Sunday: priced in zone 3, at 125.00.
- Booked in service zone 2 for a Saturday: priced in zone 3, at 125.00.
- Booked in service zone 2 for a Wednesday: priced in zone 2, at 95.00.
- Booked in service zone 3 for a Sunday: priced in zone 3 — the band cannot go farther out.
